content: The code has no compile error. I should give this implementation to the user.

The syntax/elaboration error occurs because the erroneous code uses `always_ff @(posedge clk or posedge reset)` and references `reset`, but the module only has ports `d`, `ena`, and `q`. There is no `clk` or `reset` signal declared in this module, so the simulator cannot bind `reset`. Also, a D latch is level-sensitive, not edge-triggered, so `always_ff` with `posedge` is not appropriate.

Fix: use a level-sensitive `always @*` block (or `always_latch` without an event list) and remove the nonexistent `clk`/`reset` logic.

```verilog
module top_module (
	input d,
	input ena,
	output logic q
);

always @* begin
	if (ena)
		q = d;
end

endmodule
```
